data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Lameea means 'Mother of Moses'. This beautiful name is derived from the Quranic story of Maryam, the mother of Prophet Isa (Jesus) and As-Siddiq (Moses). This name symbolizes the unwavering faith, devotion, and strength of the noble mothers in Islamic history. The name Lameea carries the meaning “Mother of Moses” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lameea usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of moses and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Lameea belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of Moses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lameea total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Her unwavering faith and belief in Allah's promises enabled her to raise a great prophet like Moses, who led his people to the true path of Allah. The name Lameea inspires us to emulate the virtues of Maryam and strive to be strong, devoted, and spiritually enlightened mothers. It reminds us of the significance of nurturing our children with strong spiritual foundations and guiding them towards the righteous path of Allah.
